_readme: Corrections applied on top of the Google Sheet every time scripts/fetch-news.js runs.
This file wins over the sheet, so the site can be fixed here without edit access to it.
Titles are matched exactly, ignoring case and extra spaces.
suppress — titles to drop from the site entirely.
images   — replace a row's image with a file committed in this repo.
extra    — posts that are not in the sheet at all. Supports body[] for
paragraphs and gallery[] for extra photos below the body.
Delete an entry to hand control of that post back to the sheet.

extra.title: Deal Locked In! Rayhan El Grafel Signs Two-Year Deal with RWDM
extra.excerpt: Rayhan El Grafel has signed a two-year deal with RWDM, stepping up from Beerschot U21 as the Belgian side push for promotion.
body: Deal locked in! Rayhan El Grafel has officially signed a two-year deal with RWDM.
After a dominant stint with Beerschot U21, the rising star is heading to the Belgian third division.
RWDM are hunting hard for promotion after an unfortunate relegation, and El Grafel is exactly the weapon they need to fight their way back to the top.
Remember the name: El Grafel. Huge potential for greatness. The journey starts now!

extra.title: Remember the Name: Samuel Tabares Signs for Gillingham FC
extra.excerpt: Young defender Samuel Tabares has signed for Gillingham FC after development years at Fulham U21 and Southampton U21.
body: Remember the name: Samuel Tabares.
The highly talented young defender has officially put pen to paper with Gillingham FC.
Following impressive development years at Fulham U21 and Southampton U21, this move to League Two is the perfect launchpad for his senior career.
With his sights firmly set on a future in the Premier League, there is no doubt he is on the path to greatness.

extra.title: Liberian Marksman on the Move! Rufus Sackie Jr Joins African Stars
extra.excerpt: Rufus Sackie Jr has completed his transfer to Namibian giants African Stars F.C., bringing 49 goal contributions in 63 games to the Namibian top flight.
body: Liberian marksman on the move! Rufus Sackie Jr has officially completed his transfer to Namibian giants African Stars F.C. ahead of their massive CAF Champions League campaign.
With an incredible record of 41 goals and 8 assists in just 63 games, the Liberian international is primed to take the Namibian top flight by storm.
But the club level isn't his only target — Rufus has his eyes firmly set on representing Liberia at the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations.
Welcome our new marksman to D.D Sports Management Agency.

extra.title: The Congolese Sniper Is Locked and Loaded
extra.excerpt: Ten goal contributions in just eight pre-season games — Laudry Mukaba is locked and loaded ahead of a massive season with Sua Flamingoes.
body: The Congolese Sniper is locked and loaded.
Laudry Mukaba is absolutely tearing up the pre-season. Ten goal contributions in just eight games is an unbelievable stat line for the young international.
The hard work is paying off and this is only the beginning of a massive season ahead. Remember the name.

extra.title: The Big Move Is Confirmed! Lyema Dopolo Joins African Stars
extra.excerpt: Lyema Dopolo is officially a Namibia Giant — the defender is en route to African Stars F.C. ahead of their CAF Champions League campaign.
body: The big move is confirmed! Lyema Dopolo is officially a Namibia Giant, en route to African Stars F.C.
Lyema is taking his game to the absolute highest level in African football as the team gears up for the CAF Champions League.
African Stars have been drawn against AS Mangasport in the first preliminary round, with the tie scheduled for 4–6 September 2026.
Big stage. Big ambitions. Ready to shine.

extra.title: Jacob Everson Joins BDF XI
extra.excerpt: Jacob Everson has finalised a season-long loan move to BDF XI in the Botswana Premier Division.
body: We can confirm that Jacob Everson has finalised a season-long loan move to BDF XI in the Botswana Premier Division.
We are excited to see Jacob gain valuable first-team minutes and continue his development on the big stage. Go get 'em, Jacob.

extra.title: Zungu Out!
extra.excerpt: D.D Sports Management Agency has terminated Lindokuhle Zungu's contract with the agency, effective immediately.
body: D.D Sports Management Agency has terminated Lindokuhle Zungu's contract with the agency, effective immediately.
Dontè Dorlly: "Success does not change who you are; it only reveals it. You traded our loyalty for a quick win."

extra.title: Congolese Marksman Laudry Mukaba Inks New Deal!
extra.excerpt: Laudry Mukaba has signed a two-year contract with Sua Flamingoes, with an option for a further year, ahead of the Botswana Premier Division season.
body: We are pleased to announce that Laudry Mukaba has signed a two-year contract with Sua Flamingoes, with an option for an additional year.

We extend our best wishes to Laudry Mukaba for a successful season as he prepares to compete in the Botswana Premier Division. We anticipate that his exceptional goal-scoring abilities will be prominently displayed on this platform.
Laudry Mukaba's agent, Dontè Dorlly, provided the following statement:

"Discussions are currently underway with several prominent clubs interested in monitoring his performance this season. I have engaged in numerous conversations with clubs in Egypt, Algeria, and Morocco since the opening of the transfer window, highlighting his prolific goal-scoring record. While many clubs have expressed interest, the current lack of professional game experience has temporarily precluded his immediate integration into their squads.

Furthermore, his limited national team experience has impacted his progression. However, we anticipate that many teams will closely observe his performance this season, and should all go favorably, we foresee his transition to a more significant opportunity."

extra.title: Done Deal! Lindokuhle Zungu Puts Pen to Paper for the Ostriches
extra.excerpt: Lindokuhle Zungu has signed a 1+1 deal with Orapa United in the Botswana Premier Division.
body: Lindokuhle Zungu puts pen to paper for the Ostriches!
Zungu has signed a 1+1 deal with Orapa United in the Botswana Premier Division.
We extend our best wishes to Zungu for a successful season ahead.

extra.title: Project Concluded: Lyema Dopolo Completes His Season with Ongos F.C.
extra.excerpt: Lyema Dopolo closes his season at Ongos F.C. with 18 clean sheets in 30 matches, captaining the side to 4th place in the Namibian Premier Division.
body: Lyema Dopolo has successfully completed his season with Ongos F.C. in the Namibian Premier Division, delivering an exceptional performance that included 18 clean sheets across 30 matches.
He also led the team as captain to a commendable 4th place finish within the Namibian Premier Division.
Lyema's agent, Dontè Dorlly, expressed immense satisfaction with Lyema's consistent performance throughout the season.
It is unfortunate that no awards were presented, as Lyema garnered over 10 Man of the Match accolades. We anticipate a promising future for this talented individual.
Discussions were held with clubs in the Serbian Premier Division and Belgium; however, logistical constraints prevented his timely travel for evaluations.
We are currently engaged in ongoing discussions with interested clubs within Africa and anticipate finalizing a substantive opportunity for him in the near future.
